arxiv-2102-11564.title: Monotone cubic spline interpolation for functions with a strong gradient
arxiv-2102-11564.creator: Francesc Aràndiga, Antonio Baeza, Dionisio F. Yáñez
arxiv-2102-11564.description: Abstract Spline interpolation has been used in several applications due to its favorable properties regarding smoothness and accuracy of the interpolant. However, when there exists a discontinuity or a steep gradient in the data, some artifacts can appear due to the Gibbs phenomenon.

arxiv-2106-13175.title: Comparing Shadows of Blackhole and Naked Singularity
arxiv-2106-13175.creator: Kanwar Preet Kaur, Pankaj S. Joshi, Dipanjan Dey, Ashok B. Joshi, Rucha P. Desai
arxiv-2106-13175.description: Abstract It is now theoretically well established that not only a black hole can cast shadow, but other compact objects such as naked singularities, gravastar or boson stars can also cast shadows. An intriguing fact that has emerged is that the event horizon and the photon sphere are not necessary for a shadow to form.

arxiv-2304-14260.title: Multi-field inflation with large scalar fluctuations: non-Gaussianity and perturbativity
arxiv-2304-14260.creator: and David J. Mulryne
arxiv-2304-14260.description: Abstract Recently multi-field inflation models that can produce large scalar fluctuations on small scales have drawn a lot of attention, primarily because they could lead to primordial black hole production and generation of large second-order gravitational waves. In this work, we focus on models where the scalar fields responsible for inflation live on a hyperbolic field space.

arxiv-2308-01125.title: Stereo Visual Odometry with Deep Learning-Based Point and Line Feature Matching using an Attention Graph Neural Network
arxiv-2308-01125.creator: Shenbagaraj Kannapiran, Nalin Bendapudi, Ming-Yuan Yu, Devarth Parikh, Spring Berman, Ankit Vora, Gaurav Pandey
arxiv-2308-01125.description: Abstract Robust feature matching forms the backbone for most Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (vSLAM), visual odometry, 3D reconstruction, and Structure from Motion (SfM) algorithms. However, recovering feature matches from texture-poor scenes is a major challenge and still remains an open area of research.

arxiv-2402-01564.title: Switching of Magnetization in Quantum Antiferromagnets with Time-Dependent Control Fields
arxiv-2402-01564.creator: Asliddin Khudoyberdiev, Götz S. Uhrig
arxiv-2402-01564.description: Abstract Ultrafast manipulation of magnetic states is one of the necessities in modern data storage technology. Quantum antiferromagnets are promising candidates in this respect. The orientation of the order parameter, the sublattice magnetization, can be used to encode “0” and “1” of a bit.

arxiv-2501-07331.title: Efficient Event-based Delay Learning in Spiking Neural Networks
arxiv-2501-07331.creator: Balázs Mészáros, James C. Knight, Thomas Nowotny
arxiv-2501-07331.description: Abstract Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) compute using sparse communication and are attracting increased attention as a more energy-efficient alternative to traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). While standard ANNs are stateless, spiking neurons are stateful and hence intrinsically recurrent, making them well-suited for spatio-temporal tasks. However, the duration of this intrinsic memory is limited by synaptic and membrane time constants.

arxiv-2508-01516.title: Hybrid quantum-classical framework for Betti number estimation with applications to topological data analysis
arxiv-2508-01516.creator: Nhat A. Nghiem, Junseo Lee, Tzu-Chieh Wei
arxiv-2508-01516.description: Abstract Topological data analysis (TDA) is a rapidly growing area that applies techniques from algebraic topology to extract robust features from large-scale data. A key task in TDA is the estimation of (normalized) Betti numbers, which capture essential topological invariants.

arxiv-2511-11605.title: PACE Solver Description: twin_width_fmi
arxiv-2511-11605.creator: David Balaban, Adrian Miclăuş
arxiv-2511-11605.description: Abstract In this paper we present twin_width_fmi ’s solver for the heuristic track of PACE’s 2025 competition on Minimum Dominating Set. As a baseline, we implement greedy-ln , a standard greedy dominating-set heuristic that repeatedly selects the vertex that newly dominates the largest number of currently undominated vertices.

arxiv-2512-17569.title: Bayesian Optimisation: Which Constraints Matter?
arxiv-2512-17569.creator: Xietao Wang Lin, Juan Ungredda, Max Butler, James Town, Alma Rahat, Hemant Singh, Juergen Branke
arxiv-2512-17569.description: Abstract . Bayesian optimisation has proven to be a powerful tool for expensive global black-box optimisation problems. In this paper, we propose new Bayesian optimisation variants of the popular Knowledge Gradient acquisition functions for problems with decoupled black-box constraints, in which subsets of the objective and constraint functions may be evaluated independently.

Activation of Tregs by TCR engagement results in upregulation of Foxp3 expre

pmc-11591020.title: N-3 Fatty Acids in Seafood Influence the Association Between the Composite Dietary Antioxidant Index and Depression: A Community-Based Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-11591020.creator: Junhwi Moon, Minji Kim, Yangha Kim, Adrianne Bendich
pmc-11591020.description: Accumulating evidence suggests that seafood and its components, such as eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), are associated with mental health. However, little is known regarding whether the status of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) modify the effect of dietary antioxidants on depression.

pmc-12533081.title: Combined IFN-γ and TNF-α treatment enhances the susceptibility of breast cancer cells and spheroids to Natural Killer cell-mediated killing
pmc-12533081.creator: Francesca Barberini, Riccardo Pietroni, Simone Ielpo, Valeria Lucarini, Daniela Nardozi, Ombretta Melaiu, Monica Benvenuto, Chiara Focaccetti, Camilla Palumbo, Federica Rossin, Doriana Fruci, Daniel Olive, Laura Masuelli, Roberto Bei, Loredana Cifaldi
pmc-12533081.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). NK cell-based immunotherapy of solid tumors has been shown to be increasingly successful, but much effort is still needed to optimize its efficacy. This study explores the effects of treatment with low, non-toxic doses of IFN-γ and TNF-α on the susceptibility of breast cancer (BC) cell lines (MCF-7, MDA-MB-231, and MDA-MB-468) cultured in 2D and 3D as spheroids, to NK cell-mediated antitumor function.

pmc-12581260.title: Women’s experiences of communication and supportive care during labour: a qualitative study in rural KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa
pmc-12581260.creator: Silondile Luthuli, Christiane Horwood, Veronique Filippi, Lyn Haskins, Sphindile Mapumulo, Tanya Doherty
pmc-12581260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundQuality maternal care is crucial to improve outcomes for both mothers and newborns. Many initiatives to improve maternal care concentrate on improving clinical practice. However, women’s experiences of care are also important determinants of health outcomes. Establishing strong interpersonal relationships between health workers and women is essential for delivering high-quality person-centered care, with health workers who empathize with women, respect their needs and concerns, and communicate effectively.

pmc-13071755.title: Phenotypic Plasticity in Arabidopsis thaliana Is Fitness‐Neutral, and Costs Are Lacking Across Experimental Environments
pmc-13071755.creator: Maya L. Shamsid‐Deen, Kenneth D. Whitney
pmc-13071755.description: Phenotypic plasticity produces multiple phenotypes depending on the environment, and its evolutionary trajectory is determined by the fitness consequences of those phenotypes. Adaptive plasticity in traits would reduce plasticity in fitness across the range of environments experienced by a species. However, it is unclear how often plasticity is adaptive, neutral, or maladaptive.

pmc-13254165.title: A disulfide-bridged single-stranded DNA nanotube for co-delivery of siRNA and chemotherapeutics in ovarian cancer therapy
pmc-13254165.creator: Yan Luo, Aoxue Guo, Tianxin Sheng, Liting Han, Chuanqi Gu, Xin Li, Congzhou Chen, Xiaolong Shi
pmc-13254165.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionUsing DNA nanotechnology, we designed a disulfide-bridged single-stranded DNA nanotube (SS-DNT) functionalized with external aptamers for targeting, and encapsulating chemotherapeutic agents internally to induce apoptosis in cancer cells.MethodsThe SS-DNT itself and the siRNA attachment points are linked via disulfide bonds, which can be fully cleaved in the intracellular glutathione (GSH) environment of tumors, thereby enhancing the release efficiency of the drug and siRNA.

pmc-13638277.creator: Manuela Chiavarini, Irene Giacchetta
pmc-13638277.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ndomised controlled study among pregnant women in Eastern Region of Ghana. BMC Pregnancy Childbirth. 2024 Aug 16;24(1):546. doi: 10.1186 /s12884-024-06743-1. PMID: 39152408; PMCID: PMC11328422. Implications for practice and research

The implementation of group-based antenatal care (G-ANC) should be prioritised, as it significantly enhances patient satisfaction and improves maternal and neonatal health outcomes, ensuring the sustainability and success of this intervention while contributing to holistic and equitable maternity care practices.
